page_title: RAY 2-0 ALA | Rayo Vallecano v Alaves 15/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+5' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
90+3' Jon Karrikaburu (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Alvaro Garcia.
87' Here is a change. Unai Lopez is going off and Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
85' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
83' Here's the change. Luis Rioja leaves the pitch and Jon Karrikaburu (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
82' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Alvaro Garcia feeds Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
79' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Stole Dimitrievski has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
78' Alaves couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
77' The substitution has been made. Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Sergio Camello.
77' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Isi Palazon will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
74' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Victor Garcia signals.
74' Luis Rioja (Alaves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
69' Substitution. Ruben Duarte did his best and is replaced by Javi Lopez (Alaves).
68' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Kike Garcia and he is replaced by Samu (Alaves).
67' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Kike Perez.
65' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Luis Rioja (Alaves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
64' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) causes Antonio Sivera little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
64' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Alex Sola is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
64' Substitution. Ianis Hagi (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jon Guridi walks off.
63' Luis Rioja (Alaves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.

61' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Antonio Sivera inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
59' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
56' Alex Sola (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
54' Jon Guridi (Alaves) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
52' CHANCE! Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Antonio Sivera, who produces an excellent reflex save.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Alex Sola (Alaves) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+3' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+1' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Antonio Sivera into the bottom right corner.
43' The Rayo Vallecano players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
42' Referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Rayo Vallecano. Let’s see what happens!
41' A player from Alaves pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Rayo Vallecano.
41' Alex Sola (Alaves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
40' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
39' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
38' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Antonio Sivera makes a save.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
35' Kike Garcia (Alaves) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
34' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
31' Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
30' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
28' Alex Sola (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Kike Garcia (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
25' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick.
25' Having seen unsporting behavior, Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Luis Garcia Plaza (Alaves) is the recipient.
23' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
21' Luis Rioja (Alaves) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
19' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card from Victor Garcia after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
17' Alex Sola (Alaves) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
16' A long pass, executed by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
14' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

14' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
12' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
10' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

9' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
8' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
8' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' A pass by Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Jon Guridi (Alaves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Jon Guridi (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
2' Half-chance! Ruben Duarte (Alaves) plays a pass into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
